name: engineer-flow
description: Framework-agnostic engineering orchestration for AI coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Framework-agnostic engineering orchestrator with sparse specialist routing.
interface.longDescription: Engineer Flow combines generalized internal engineering capabilities with user-installed external Agent Skills, activates at most two development specialists, and requires post-development security verification.
